meaning: A recorded message left by a caller who could not reach you. You listen to it later.
clues: It is a message you hear, not read, after you miss a call.
The caller talks, and the phone records their voice.
On many phones you see a list of them and tap one to play it.
Callers hear your greeting first, then leave their message.
It is one word with nine letters. It starts with V.
assumes: A text message is a short written message
Caller ID shows who is calling
Call waiting beeps when a second caller rings

decoys.meaning: A short written message sent from one phone to another.
A feature that shows who is calling before you answer.
A beep during a call that tells you someone else is trying to reach you.

exchange.text: My cousin kept messages on a tiny tape. Press play, hear the beep, hear Aunt Sue.
